title: Create Compose 3dm Bundle with Ui and Rhp Packages
description: Create compose/3dm bundle with one npm package `ui` and one .NET package `rhp`. The ui displays a tree view from sketchpad in the side panel using compose js. It has actions to import kits and import models into the active Rhino document. When importing a model, use the layer structure: compose > KITNAME > Types > TYPENAME > Models > MODELTAGS. The Rhino tree for the sidepanel is: Kits (Import) > KIT > Types > TYPE > Models > Model (Import), Designs > Design. Uses the react_rhino_connector plan and Speckle architecture as reference.
summary: Fixed 3 compilation errors in Compose.Rhino bundle. (1) Removed Grasshopper GH_AssemblyInfo class (not a GH plugin). (2) Multi-targeted net8.0;net48 following gh pattern, added conditional compilation (#if NETFRAMEWORK) for WinForms/WebView2 ComposePanel and ShowComposeCommand. (3) Fixed Layer type collision (Compose.Layer vs Rhino.DocObjects.Layer) using RhinoLayer alias with global:: qualifier. Also fixed Rhino.FileIO namespace collision via global::, fixed Panels.RegisterPanel Icon argument, removed non-existent Layer.GetObjects() call, and fixed RhinoApp.ExeVersion to RhinoApp.Version. All 13 xUnit tests pass on net8.0. UI Vite build follows same pattern as other monorepo apps (pre-existing CSS resolution issue in compose/js/globals.css affects all apps equally).
